newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends steady in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends steady in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed steady at 42.64 to the dollar in the kerb market on Wednesday in dull trading as players awaited the outcome of the government's talks with a visiting IMF delegation on a standby loan agreement.
They said the rupee was likely to fall on Thursday as the players usually switch to the dollar before the Friday weekend.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 rupee to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 6.50 percent. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
